mogra 0.1 - Raag Identifier, English only.
Left to right: the whole flow. Home -> Set Sa -> Record -> Analysing -> Result.
Set Sa is Option A: explicit tabs (hum / pick a note / Hz). Option B (tuner-first) is parked, not deleted.

Keyboard now drags.

One octave on screen. It opens on C3-B3 - the same octave as before - and drags down to A2 and up to E4, so male Sa (C3-E3) and higher Sa both sit inside the range. The octave -/+ stepper is gone; the rail under the keys shows where you are.
